Real Fr34CanaryCommandProofSource and native proof verification run in dynamic receiving/gate tests.

B4-3.correction: Blocked starts LookupRequired/Unknown; common installed wrapper converts malformed/missing local inputs conservatively; both owner entrypoints retain uncertain state and known original identity. Three local-fault subcases exercise both actual entrypoints without cohort transport.

B4-4.correction: Per-pending completion liability, explicit terminal admission, durable paged migration with bounded cache, pre-publication conditional reservations and stable content-addressed request/result bodies. Failed/competing CAS pressure, capacity loss, restart, repeated retained results and legacy publication carry-forward are covered.

First sequence is bounded to the existing native authorization call sequence; unknown restart cannot dispatch. Fully restored missing receipt remains Unknown.
